title: Deferred event-condition scheduler findings
scope: Consumer and scheduler side of the deferred Event::Base event-condition paths first surfaced by the event-condition-consumer-findings pass.

handoffPipeline.summary: For Push event-condition receivers, forwards the receiver key/shape fields into FUN_006F2B70.
Builds the condition payload, wraps the actor/control pointer, and calls FUN_0075C4A0.
Writes the resolved two-slot, 0x54-stride callback table entry.

executionPipeline.summary: Call Event::Base virtual slot +0x1c. True selects the block state machine; false selects the non-block enqueue path.
Classifies virtual slot +0x20 state and dispatches current/continuation block events.
Allocates a 0x2c queue node, inserts it into owner+0x14, and dispatches through FUN_008963F0.
Scans 16-byte vector records, handles type 0x04 records through FUN_0089AD10, then reaches Event::Base virtual slot +0x04 and the event-condition-consumer-findings leaf slot +0x28 firers.
Walks the owner+0x14 list, one-shot invokes each node payload callback behind node+0x25, and maps node+0x28 tail data through FUN_006DE2D0.

baseCtor.summary: Installs Application::Lua::Script::Client::Event::Base::vftable, initializes the Lua string/member through FUN_00447200, and writes status byte object+0x58.

confirmedLuaCoroutineApiCalls.summary: FUN_00CF4230 calls the stripped resume-shaped Lua body FUN_00DCFD30(*param_1, param_2). The body carries the stock `cannot resume` diagnostic and resume-state checks.

FUN_00CF38D0 calls the stripped yield-shaped Lua body FUN_00DCF7D0(*param_1, 0). The body carries the stock `attempt to yield across metamethod/C-call boundary` diagnostic and yield status/stack writes.

coroutineSurface.summary: Follow-up verification found stripped Lua coroutine API callsites elsewhere in the binary, but not in the deferred event-condition scheduler. The recovered 6C continuation behavior is native event-execution state: block events keep current/continuation pointers at owner+0x08/+0x0c, FUN_00897290 installs a continuation object, FUN_00896950 re-dispatches through FUN_008962C0 when its gate passes, and FUN_008955C0 walks the non-block execution list.

negativeFindings.finding: No separate heap queue of EventCondition leaf objects was found.
negativeFindings.basis: Producer-side storage is the two-slot 0x54 callback table. Non-block runtime queuing uses 0x2c EventExecutionQueueNode wrappers around execution payloads.

negativeFindings.finding: The deferred event-condition scheduler does not use the recovered Lua coroutine API callsites.
negativeFindings.basis: Follow-up verification confirmed lua_resume/lua_yield-shaped bodies through stock diagnostic strings and client wrappers at FUN_00CF4230/FUN_00CF38D0. The 6C call graph still exposes native continuation/state-machine helpers and no calls into FUN_00DCFD30 or FUN_00DCF7D0.
